items.headline: Anthropic signs $3.4B generator deal with OnePWR for 1.7GW of AI data-center backup power
items.why: Shows AI labs now buying physical infra (generators, power) directly, not just chips — capex intensity keeps rising

items.headline: OpenAI closes $11B of a funding round at $1.25T valuation, below its original $1.4T/$30B target
items.why: Signals AI investors pulling back after the AI-stock selloff; OpenAI cut its raise target amid capex-spending concerns

items.headline: Google to invest $17B in Wyoming AI data center campus bought from Crusoe
items.why: Adds to hyperscaler capex arms race underpinning AI infrastructure demand

items.headline: Tencent launches Hy4 open-weight AI model, says it beats DeepSeek-V4.1 and Alibaba rivals on benchmarks
items.why: Intensifies China's open-weight model race (Tencent, DeepSeek, Alibaba, Z.ai), pressuring model moats and pricing

items.headline: Shield AI to reach $28.8B valuation via $5.3B radar-maker acquisition plus $2.5B new funding (incl. $1B Series H)
items.why: Major defense-AI consolidation; signals AI capital flowing into hardware/sensor M&A, not just models

items.headline: PBOC shifts policy anchor to overnight repo rate, cuts PSL rate 25bp in de facto easing move
items.why: Signals further China monetary easing; supports liquidity/risk appetite for China AI equities like Alibaba, Tencent.

items.headline: Anthropic discloses plan for up to $895B in compute spending commitments and ~$17B revenue run-rate ahead of IPO
items.why: Quantifies the scale of AI-lab capex/compute lock-in investors are underwriting via the IPO

items.headline: Marvell agrees to combine with Lumentum in ~$115B deal
items.why: Consolidates AI custom-silicon (Marvell) with optical/data-center components (Lumentum), key AI-infra supply chain tie-up

items.headline: Anthropic amends IPO filing with Q3 results, targets $1.8T-$2T valuation ahead of pre-Thanksgiving listing
items.why: Would be the largest AI-lab IPO to date, re-rating private AI valuations and offering public AI-lab exposure

items.headline: OpenAI cuts new funding round target by ~$10B to ~$20B amid AI-stock selloff, still eyes $1.25T valuation
items.why: Signals investor caution on AI financing pace even for the top lab; bridge round ahead of a planned 2027 IPO

items.headline: Anthropic's annualized revenue run rate topped $80B in October, up from $65B in July, according to The Wall Street Journal
items.why: Rapid run-rate growth underpins its IPO pitch, but investors are reportedly questioning whether the targeted ~$1.5T valuation is justified

items.headline: Samsung says its 2027 HBM memory supply is already sold out
items.why: Confirms HBM scarcity extending another year, supporting pricing power for memory makers feeding AI chip demand

items.headline: ECB holds deposit rate at 2.50% as eurozone inflation hits 3.8%
items.why: Signals ECB tightening bias into Dec; higher-for-longer EU rates pressure growth-stock multiples incl. AI names

items.headline: Fed holds rates at 3.75%-4% in 10-2 vote, two dissents favored a hike
items.why: Rate path directly affects valuations of long-duration AI growth stocks and cost of debt funding AI capex

items.headline: Fed holds rates steady at 4% at October FOMC meeting
items.why: Rate path directly affects valuation of long-duration AI capex and growth-stock multiples
